post.caption:
Before anyone wrote a story, someone wrote down who owed them barley. Sumerian temple accounting drove the first marks, pictographs drifted into abstract wedge symbols as scribes wrote faster, and the real leap came when signs stopped standing for things and started standing for sounds. That is what made writing able to express anything at all. It happened independently at least three times, and mostly for the same administrative reason.
